newsitem.title: FRANCE: Iraqi wheat tender keeps grain market in suspense.
newsitem.headline: Iraqi wheat tender keeps grain market in suspense.

text.p: European grain exporters were still waiting on Tuesday afternoon for an official word from Iraq in marathon talks for the purchase of 100,000 tonnes of French wheat.
Iraq, which bought 300,000 tonnes of French wheat in December, has been negotiating since January 14 a new wheat purchase under a United Nations oil-for-food deal.
Exporters were trying to get to the bottom of market rumours Iraq had already bought some wheat from France and Australia, but stressed no official word of a deal had yet emerged.
Several exporters however said they could not rule out Iraq might announce a decision later tonight.
On Monday exporters estimated Iraq may end up buying more wheat from France, possibly as much as 350,000 tonnes.
